Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Johnston Asset Management Boosted Its Occidental Pete Del (OXY) Stake by $6.72 Million; As Jpm (JPM) Market Value Rose, Fulton Breakefield Broenniman Boosted Position by $8.70 Million 
April 23, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Johnston Asset Management Corp increased its stake in Occidental Pete Corp Del (OXY) by 81.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Johnston Asset Management Corp bought 92,120 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 204,570 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.07M, up from 112,450 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Johnston Asset Management Corp who had been investing in Occidental Pete Corp Del for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $58.95 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.68% or $0.52 during the last trading session, reaching $76.99. About 2.36 million shares traded. Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) has risen 4.69% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.86% the S&P500. 
Fulton Breakefield Broenniman Llc increased its stake in Jpm (JPM) by 427.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fulton Breakefield Broenniman Llc bought 82,041 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.67% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 101,251 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.83M, up from 19,210 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fulton Breakefield Broenniman Llc who had been investing in Jpm for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $377.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.60% or $0.67 during the last trading session, reaching $110.8. About 7.80M shares traded. JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) has risen 23.99% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.44% the S&P500. 
Among 22 analysts covering Occidental Petroleum Corporation ( NYSE:OXY ), 6 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 15 Hold. Therefore 27% are positive. Occidental Petroleum Corporation had 90 analyst reports since August 3, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Barclays Capital maintained it with “Underweight” rating and $40 target in Wednesday, October 11 report. The stock of Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) has “Hold” rating given on Friday, May 5 by BMO Capital Markets. On Thursday, January 18 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Buy”. As per Tuesday, July 18, the company rating was maintained by Cowen & Co. Jefferies maintained the shares of OXY in report on Friday, January 19 with “Hold” rating. The company was maintained on Monday, April 3 by Jefferies. The firm has “Buy” rating by Credit Agricole given on Tuesday, December 15. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Monday, May 9 by JP Morgan. Piper Jaffray maintained Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) on Thursday, August 24 with “Hold” rating. On Friday, July 28 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Hold”. 
Johnston Asset Management Corp, which manages about $4.21B and $2.36 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Stanley Black & Decker Inc (NYSE:SWK) by 2,330 shares to 317,055 shares, valued at $53.80M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in James Hardie Inds Plc (NYSE:JHX) by 1.29M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 10,470 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
